introduction: Ohio Works First offers temporary cash support to eligible families while adults prepare for employment. Your county JFS assesses the request.
description: Ohio Works First offers temporary cash support to eligible families while adults prepare for employment. Your county JFS assesses the request.

sections.who: The program is income-based and serves qualifying families with children. The county determines household eligibility, participation duties and any exceptions.
sections.get: Assistance helps meet immediate family needs. The usual lifetime limit is 36 months; ask the county about your history and any hardship extension.
sections.docs:
• Household and income records.
  • Identity and requested child or family relationship evidence.
  • Previous cash-assistance information and any barriers to participation.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Use Ohio Benefits or your county JFS.

  2. Complete assessment

    Discuss work, child care, transport and other circumstances relevant to the plan.

  3. Read the requirements

    Ask the worker to explain your participation agreement, reporting duties and payment decision.
sections.after: Keep appointments and discuss barriers promptly rather than missing required activities without contacting the worker.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using County OWF overview; OWF questions; State interview rule. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: It is temporary assistance with program limits.

Where do I explain child care problems?
Discuss them with the worker during assessment and when circumstances change.
What should I do after approval?
Follow the notice and participation plan, and report changes as instructed.
